profile.headline: Front End Developer | Building High Performing Teams | Creating Strategic Partnerships | Apple Evangelist
profile.summary:
Web Developer with an insatiable desire to build projects with a lasting impact. Dynamic communicator and
problem-solving team player excels under pressure and on teams driven by productivity and accountability. 

Github: https://github.com/dccruz

positions.title: Web Developer / Senior Account Manager
positions.description:
• Managed and maintain  department training website.
• Responsible to make website template including layout and design.
• Onboarding Support (training, documentation and product updates)

positions.title: Student Web Developer
positions.description: Used fundamental coding skills (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript etc) to build fully functional and responsive websites; Wireframed new sites, registered domain names, oversaw hosting and file transfer protocol, and debugged problem pages.

positions.title: Corporate Relations Social Media Rep
positions.description:
●	Assisted social media planning and execution of social media platforms including Facebook & Twitter.
●	Resolved escalated customer issues through Twitter.

positions.title: Assistant Store Manager
positions.description:
Lead high-performing, 35 member team of Apple Geniuses and Family Room Specialists engaging with customers to provide computer/device repairs and repair relationships. 

-Interface with customers and monitor daily operations to ensure alignment with Apple’s goals and vision.
-Leverage Lominger Competencies talent management strategies to mentor team members and provide opportunities for growth. 
-Assisted in transforming underperforming Family Room to highest performing store in SF North district for on-time percentage, average wait time, and session duration.
